deck.name: AWS Fundamentals
deck.description: Core AWS services and concepts, at roughly Cloud Practitioner level.

questions.prompt: Which AWS service is object storage?
Which AWS service provides resizable virtual servers?
Which service runs code without you managing servers, billing per request and compute time?
What is the maximum timeout for a single AWS Lambda invocation?
Which service is a managed relational database for engines such as MySQL and PostgreSQL?
Which service is a fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database?
Amazon Aurora is compatible with which database engines?
Which service manages users, groups, roles and permissions?
IAM is a global service, not tied to a single region.
What is an AWS Availability Zone?
choices: One or more isolated data centers within a Region
A geographic area containing multiple Availability Zones
A worldwide network of edge locations serving cached content
An isolated virtual network created within a single AWS Region
questions.explanation: An Availability Zone is an isolated location within a Region, with redundant power, networking and connectivity.

questions.prompt: Which service lets you launch AWS resources in a logically isolated virtual network?
Which service is AWS's content delivery network (CDN)?
Which service provides DNS and domain registration?
Which service collects metrics and logs and sets alarms on them?
Which service records the API calls made in your AWS account, for auditing?
Which service is a fully managed message queue for decoupling applications?
questions.explanation: SQS is a queue that consumers poll. SNS pushes messages to many subscribers.

questions.prompt: Which service publishes one message to many subscribers, such as email, SMS or Lambda?
Which service provides block storage volumes attached to EC2 instances?
Which S3 storage class family is designed for low-cost long-term archiving?
What durability is Amazon S3 Standard designed for?
questions.explanation: Durability describes protection against data loss. It is different from the availability of a service.

questions.prompt: S3 bucket names must be globally unique (within a partition such as standard AWS regions).
Under the shared responsibility model, what is AWS responsible for?
choices: Configuring customer application access and account permissions
Maintaining customer operating systems on self-managed instances
Protecting physical infrastructure and the services running it
Classifying customer data and setting application security policies
questions.explanation: AWS describes its part as security of the cloud. Customer responsibilities vary by the service used.

questions.prompt: Which service lets you define infrastructure as code with JSON or YAML templates?
Which service creates and controls encryption keys?
Which service stores and automatically rotates database credentials and API keys?
Security groups are stateful, while network ACLs are stateless.
questions.explanation: With a security group, return traffic for an allowed request is allowed automatically. Network ACLs need explicit rules in both directions.

questions.prompt: Which EC2 purchasing option offers large discounts but can be interrupted when AWS needs the capacity back?
Which service distributes incoming traffic across multiple targets such as EC2 instances?
Which services run Docker containers on AWS with managed orchestration?
What is the AWS-recommended practice for the account root user?
questions.answer: Turn on MFA, don't create access keys for it, and use it only for the few tasks that require it.
